extracted.name: Eggnog latte
extracted.description: Get into the festive spirit with an eggnog latte. If you don’t have a coffee machine, simply heat the milk gently in a pan while whisking until frothy
ingredient_lines: 100ml milk steamed and whisked until frothy
pinch each of nutmeg and ground cinnamon to serve
instruction_lines: Pour the espresso into a large mug. Top with most of the frothy milk, then the eggnog or advocaat.
Stir, add the rest of the milk and sprinkle with the nutmeg and cinnamon to serve.
